firstPlayerRule: The person wearing the greatest number of colors starts by revealing a card.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose a starting player randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: This entry describes the competitive mode. Cooperative mode has everyone search for matching patterns simultaneously.
